analyzer.body1: By default the analyzer runs in <bold>rules</bold> mode — a lightweight, multilingual rule engine (English, Azerbaijani, Russian) that needs no model downloads.
analyzer.body2: To use a Hugging Face model instead, set the ANALYZER environment variable on the server. This is configured server-side and cannot be changed from the app.
